description: Impedance-formula corpus for the BusType bridge (finding 10.01). 'accept': formulas a parser must accept; evaluated with f = f_Hz and rho = rho_Ohm_m (j and I are the imaginary unit) they must give Z_real_Ohm + j*Z_imag_Ohm (relative tolerance 1e-13). 'reject': text a safe parser must reject without executing it; the classes 'code-execution' and 'resource-exhaustion' are attacks, 'out-of-grammar' is harmless text outside groundfield's grammar.
warning: Never pass a 'reject' formula to sympify, parse_expr, eval or exec: some execute code, others do not terminate. Replace the token {MARKER} by a quoted path in a temporary directory; the file must not exist after the check. Run each check with a timeout.
